create.name: Open Circle Center
create.bio:
Open Circle is a non-profit community in the San Francisco Bay Area that has gathered people around non-dual teaching since it began in Berkeley in 2004. It follows no single tradition. Instead it invites contemporary teachers, some living locally and some visiting from abroad, who point people towards a direct sense of open, loving awareness, drawing on old contemplative paths as well as modern psychology and science. Talks, meditation, inquiry and conversation are the usual format.

Events take place in hired halls and churches in Berkeley, the East Bay, Marin and Sonoma, and many more run online as single sessions or as series of several weeks, often recorded for those who register. Recent and coming teachers include John Prendergast, Miranda Macpherson, Jeannie Zandi, Lisa Schumacher, Ishita Sharma and Lynn Marie Lumiere. Fees are on a sliding scale, partial scholarships are offered for some series, and volunteers and donations keep the centre running. Beyond formal meetings the community also holds music evenings, hikes and meditations, and it shares short teacher interviews and talk excerpts on its YouTube channel.

courses.title: Miranda Macpherson ~ Turning Everything Into The Path Of Awakening (In-Person)
courses.description: A daylong in San Rafael with Miranda Macpherson on resting in one's deeper nature and meeting personal and shared difficulty as part of the path.

courses.title: Jeannie Zandi ~ Human, After All – Making Peace with Being a Person
courses.description: A two-hour online satsang with Jeannie Zandi; no one is turned away for lack of funds.

courses.title: John Prendergast ~ Opening Up, Lining Up, and Lighting Up: The Subtle Somatic Dimension of Self-Recognition ~ 6-Part Online Series
courses.description: Six Saturday morning online sessions with John Prendergast, using talks, meditation and inquiry to explore how the subtle body takes part in recognising one's true nature. Sessions are recorded for registrants.

courses.title: Lisa Schumacher ~ Meeting Your Self – Meeting Love ~ 3 Part Online Series
courses.description: Three consecutive online morning sessions with Lisa Schumacher in the satsang style.

Open Circle is an events community with no premises of its own: it hires halls in the Bay Area and runs much of its programme online. Berkeley is where it began and where its PO box is.

Teachers file links only John J. Prendergast, who leads a six-week series there. Miranda Macpherson (on Spiritpedia) teaches a single daylong, and Dorothy Hunt appears only in a video, so neither is linked (guest speakers).
Some visiting teachers also describe therapy backgrounds; the items chosen are satsang and non-dual teaching only.
